### Are You Blind to Spiritual Reality?
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-june-25-2024.html
Passage: Matthew 13:44
Points:
- Christ's earthly ministry uncovered and displayed the hidden treasure of the kingdom of heaven.
- Despite witnessing His miraculous power directly, religious opponents were blind to who Jesus really was.
- Failing to perceive the King left them unable to receive the spiritual reality right in their midst.
- Believers must humble their hearts so God can open their spiritual eyes to the kingdom.

### He Sold All His Pearls for One
Author: David Mathis
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/he-sold-all-his-pearls-for-one
Passage: Matthew 13:45-46
Points:
- The merchant's search illustrates the supreme, incomparable worth of Christ and His kingdom.
- True discipleship demands parting with every other prized possession to lay hold of the singular treasure.
- Just as Mary poured out costly perfume and Paul surrendered pedigree, believers count all else loss for Jesus.
- The surpassing joy of possessing Christ far outweighs any earthly cost or sacrifice.
